A Bockstein contradiction proves a minimal differential has order exactly one. Separately, one-character elliptic-unit comparisons give constant valuations at all sufficiently high roots of unity, and horizontal nonnegativity controls all height-one divisors away from 2.
construction_ideas.mechanism: The Bockstein first establishes generic concentration without assuming a global point spans. For U=π^a ε P/Q with coprime distinguished P,Q, horizontal nonnegativity forces Q=1. Constant high-character valuations then force deg P=0. Thus U has order zero at the center, and the exact triangle gives ord_v Z=1. The independently proved torsion-trace implication turns Z′≠0 into the required nontrivial point and only then the known-rank formulas apply.
